    Presenter Information

    Presentation Material Submission

    All presenting authors should submit their presentation materials via the AACL-IJCNLP 2026 presentation submission portal by November 2, 2026. For step-by-step instructions, please read the Presentation Recording & Submission Guide.

    • Pre-recorded presentation video
    • Poster PDF
    • Presentation slides

    Video length requirements:

    Track Pre-recorded Video
    Main conference long papers 10 minutes (required)
    Main conference short papers 5 minutes (required)
    Findings long papers 10 minutes (required)
    Findings short papers 5 minutes (required)
    Demo papers 5 minutes (required)
    SRW oral papers 10 minutes (required)
    SRW posters and workshop papers Optional (10 minutes)

    Poster PDF and slides are required for main conference, Findings, demo, and SRW papers. Workshop requirements are decided by each workshop’s organizers — please follow the instructions from your own workshop.

    Please name your files with the conference and paper ID so they can be easily identified (e.g., AACL 2026_main-291, AACL 2026_Find-456, AACL 2026_Demo-99). Maximum file size: 20 MB (PDF, PPT, PPTX).

    For detailed recording instructions (environment setup, audio, and recording tools such as PowerPoint and ScreenPal), see the Presentation Recording & Submission Guide.

    If you cannot find your paper in the submission portal, please contact your workshop organizers or the conference program chairs so that the paper list can be updated.

    On-Site Poster Printing

    Posters can be printed near the conference venue (A0 portrait, color printing, 35 RMB per poster).

    • Ordering: order before 14:00, and your poster will be delivered to the registration desk by 10:00 the next day.
    • Chinese attendees: scan the QR code in the poster printing flyer to send your poster and pay via WeChat.
    • International attendees: send your poster to 3490982011@qq.com, and pay via Alipay or cash in the printing store.
    • Printing store: 顺臆图文, No.182, Poly International Main Tower, Commercial Building, No. 166 Qinlang Road, Hengqin New Area (open hours: 09:00 – 21:00)
    • Contact: +86 13543850448

    Please contact and pay the printing store directly. See the poster printing flyer (PDF) for details.
